reused_comparator_evidence.semantics: The persisted F-SI23 N512 endpoint difference is a finite same-endpoint comparator only and is not exact truth. Gate C does not rerun or deepen the N512 ladder.

purpose: Characterize whether the fixed, uncalibrated F-SI24 stiffness-aware one-linear-solve indicator transfers from the exact constant-linear theorem to the existing real nonlinear B1.10 C2 envelope strongly enough to dominate the already persisted finite N512 endpoint differences, without fitting a scale, tolerance or factor and without adding any nonlinear reference trajectory.

N1_reproduction_guard.raw_EOBS: The Gate-C N1 e_raw infinity norm must reproduce the persisted F-SI23 C2 EOBS for the same case under epsilon-scaled numerical consistency only.
N1_reproduction_guard.reason: This binds the new indicator to the already characterized C2 principal attempt rather than silently changing the trial semantics.

test_only_final_state_operator.scope: current admitted SwKimpl=0, explicit top flux, SWBOTB=5, uniform base-state conductivity, no source/root/macropore Jacobian terms
test_only_final_state_operator.storage_diagonal: M_i=C(h_N1_i,dt)*dz_i evaluated by the existing B1.10 constitutive provider at the accepted N1 candidate state
test_only_final_state_operator.darcy_face_conductances: Use the same current-solver-policy base-state face conductances as HeadCalc SwKimpl=0. Because the frozen initial profile is uniform, all node conductivities equal k0=K(h0); internal g_i=k0/disnod_i and lower-boundary g_bot=k0/disnod_(n+1).
test_only_final_state_operator.J_final: M/dt plus the symmetric tridiagonal Darcy conductance operator for explicit top flux and prescribed bottom head
test_only_final_state_operator.architectural_boundary: This reconstruction is test-only. Any later production implementation must expose solver-owned operator evaluation rather than couple other modules to HeadCalc internal arrays.

indicator.bootstrap_hdot_n: Identical source-bound F-SI23 C2 right-sided bootstrap under the prescribed bottom-head jump.
indicator.defect_solve: J_final*delta=rhs using one reference TRIDAG solve
indicator.D_inf_diagnostic: 2*max_i(abs(delta_i)); report only, never call it a theorem-derived bound
indicator.factor_two: fixed analytic Gate-A/Gate-B factor; not calibrated on B1.10

finite_comparator.E1_512: Persisted F-SI23 C2 max_i|h_N1-h_N512| for the identical case
finite_comparator.negative_transfer_rule: B_inf < E1_512 is negative nonlinear transfer evidence because the candidate does not dominate even the finite N512 difference
finite_comparator.if_all_15_positive: Call only FINITE_COMPARATOR_CONSISTENT_NONLINEAR_CHARACTERIZATION. Do not call B_inf a true-error bound and do not promote N512 to exact truth.

pass_rules_for_harness: All 15 N1 principal HeadCalc attempts converge under the frozen C2 controls or the first model failure is persisted without changing the matrix.
Every N1 principal attempt passes the unchanged hard external mass gate.
N1 EOBS reproduces the persisted F-SI23 C2 EOBS for the same case under epsilon-scaled numerical consistency only.
Final-state capacities and all M_i are finite and strictly positive.
The reconstructed J_final is finite, symmetric in its off-diagonal conductance pairing, and the one reference TRIDAG solve succeeds.
All indicator norms and ratios are finite when their denominators are positive.
O0 and O2 machine-readable outputs are identical.
Production Richards/runtime/adapter source remains unchanged from the F-SI24 base.
not_a_harness_pass_rule: B_inf must dominate E1_512 in every case
one global nonlinear calibration factor must exist
next_if_all_15_finite_comparator_consist: Persist an owner candidate profile that clearly separates exact linear theorem from nonlinear finite-comparator evidence. Only then decide whether a disjoint held-out F-VQ qualification is scientifically justified; do not use this 15-case matrix as held-out evidence.
next_if_any_negative_transfer: Close nonlinear transfer fail-closed for the current F-SI24 candidate while retaining the exact linear Gate-B theorem. Do not fit a nonlinear multiplier or revert to a deep production refinement ladder.
